justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Lifestyle medicine produces measurable HbA1c reduction, weight loss, and cardiovascular risk reduction. DPP-based programs show 58% T2DM prevention.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Board exam plus CME requirements; ~$500+ exam fee; significant study time investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable across chronic disease populations; relevant in primary care, cardiac, pulmonary, and diabetes rehab settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Some preventive care and chronic disease management codes apply; commercial coverage for lifestyle medicine counseling inconsistent.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Emerging demand as health systems adopt lifestyle medicine programs; not yet widely listed in rehab job postings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patient empowerment and self-management are core; high engagement when social support is built in.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Fits naturally into cash-pay wellness, weight loss, prediabetes, longevity coaching markets.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Allows positioning as integrative/lifestyle clinician at premium rates beyond traditional PT codes.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Still rare among rehab clinicians; combines well with PT/OT to create defensible niche.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Group-class and program-based delivery (e.g., CHIP) is highly leverageable across staff.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumer awareness of 'lifestyle medicine' is growing rapidly, especially in longevity-aware demographics.
justifications.business.efficiency: Multi-month coursework and exam; meaningful time investment.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized but considered more of a physician-led credential; less weight in PT/OT promotion files.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Growing literature base but not yet rehab-canonical.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Useful for health-promotion and wellness threads but peripheral to core DPT/MOT curriculum.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Solid evidence for plant-based diet/exercise/sleep interventions but heterogeneous quality.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely listed in PT/OT faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Significant cost and study time for modest academic ROI.
